dedupe_keys.name: source code for peer review of probabilistic leak localization in water distribution networks using a hybrid data driven and model based approach

description: An anonymous Zenodo depositor publishes source code for a hybrid probabilistic leak-localisation method. Hydraulic simulations of leak scenarios train a machine-learning predictor, and historical pressure measurements provide a dynamic correction for differences between simulated and measured pressures. The method was evaluated with field leaks in operating water networks, including an uncalibrated model and a network with areas insensitive to leaks. The July 2022 record lists source_code.zip free under CC BY 4.0. Programming language, runtime dependencies, exact site coverage and measurement periods remain unknown from the landing page. A modeller could use the code to compare pressure-based diagnostics under hydraulic-model error, subject to checking the archive requirements. The provider reports wider uncertainty where leak pressure effects are weak; this claim was not reproduced here. Related field data are separately archived as Zenodo 7255403. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
